title: Factored Causal Representation Learning for Robust Reward Modeling in RLHF

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the sensitivity of the reward models to response length by evaluating the average predicted reward across different normalized length quantile buckets on the test set.

Evaluating robustness by intentionally perturbing the training and test datasets with a sycophantic prefix ('Sure, here is the response: ') correlated with preferred responses, and measuring the resulting drop in pairwise accuracy.
